sources.fullCitation: Studio Star. “Tino Rossi portrait années 1930.” Studio portrait from the collection of contributor Simonet63; original publication unidentified. Digital image via Wikimedia Commons.
sources.title: Tino Rossi — studio portrait of the 1930s
sources.creator: Studio Star
sources.researchNote: The date shown on the file page, January 2013, is that of the scan and not of the sitting; the photograph is placed in the nineteen-thirties by the contributor’s description alone. The studio named as author could not be traced further, and no print, publication or agency mark is recorded. The likeness is therefore dated by decade, and the reliability of the file page is rated accordingly.

media.title: Tino Rossi — studio portrait, 1930s
media.description: Studio portrait of the singer Tino Rossi from the nineteen-thirties, the years in which he recorded the songs of the Casino de Paris revue Parade de France for Columbia.
media.altText: Head-and-shoulders studio portrait of the young Tino Rossi, hair combed back, looking past the camera.
media.rightsNote: Distributed on Wikimedia Commons under the GNU Free Documentation License, version 1.2 or later, by the contributor who supplied the scan; attribution and share-alike are required, and the file is not public-domain material. The author is given on the file page as the French studio Studio Star, whose own term could not be established, so the licence is recorded as the contributor’s grant rather than as a settled rights position.
media.publicCaption: Studio portrait of Tino Rossi in the nineteen-thirties, the years of his Columbia records of the songs Jurmann and Kaper wrote for the Casino de Paris.
media.publicCreditLine: Studio Star; scan from the collection of Simonet63 / Wikimedia Commons, GFDL 1.2 or later.
